product.name: NeClip
product.summary: Local macOS clipboard history, snippets, EN/RU layout correction and screenshot markup

features: chronological text, image and file history with bounded menu snapshots
editable snippet folders with draft-safe saves, deletion undo and local placeholders
manual EN/RU correction and conservative opt-in automatic correction
optional per-application input-source memory without keyboard monitoring
seven configurable global shortcuts with conflict recovery
explicit area and full-screen screenshots with a 32 MP capture budget
screenshot redaction, pen, arrow, rectangle and text with undo/redo and flattened PNG/JPEG export
bounded local SQLite storage, privacy exclusions and safe history cleanup
manual-only update checks using an exact manifest URL, bounded JSON and no redirects

permissions.pasteboard: Explained before monitoring; denied access fails closed on macOS 15.4+
permissions.accessibility: Optional; used for one-click paste and manual selected-text replacement
permissions.inputMonitoring: Requested only when automatic layout correction is explicitly enabled; per-application layout memory does not need it
permissions.screenRecording: Requested only for an explicit screenshot command; no launch-time screen capture

notPlanned: search, keyword fields, tags or smart collections
